text_en: Al-Hasan and al-Husayn are Imams, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them... Al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the youths of the people of Paradise.
I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from disbelief, poverty, greed, and envy. from poverty and indigence... and doubt and hypocrisy and evil... and evil character.
fi'l-imamati mutamathilun (in Imamate they are alike) and wa fi'l-darajati mutafadilun (and in ranks they are different).
No, no, that's... that is fine. This is all in its place, but it doesn't mean that. Look, when the time comes, I will tell you, and you can leave at that time.
I took from five, I gave to five, between me and my Lord are five.

Allah Ta'ala created 28 letters in the Spiritual Realm. And then those 28 letters performed a verb, an action, through which they received vowel points [zer, zabar, pesh] and dots and things like that happened.
the four groupings: the light luminous, the heavy luminous, the light tenebrous... Yes, that which is, of seven each. The third grouping, those are the letters of the speaking opposites, those seven.

from the gunaah (sin) of a mo'min, a kaafir is created. He says that the kaafir has no wujud (existence), that the gunaah (sin) we commit, Allah ta'ala gives it the shakl (shape) in the soorat (form) of a kaafir.
the Naatiq is saahib-e-naasut. And the Imam is saahib-e-naasut wa laahut, both.
all the Nutqa' - Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim (alayhis salam), all of them - were only saahib-e-naasut, they were not saahib-e-laahut.

when the naasut and laahut of the Imam is formed, then whatever maqaam (station) the soorat takes in the laahut, for example if it took the maqaam of the eye, the maqaam of the left eye in the laahut, then in the naasut as well, it will take the maqaam of the left eye with it.

Mawlana Ali's naasut, the naasut-e-taba'i, was very high. It was equivalent to the naasut-e-khaas of other a'imma. So for this reason, Mawlana Ali had to lower his own. So first you took the naasut-e-tanaasuli, but that too performed a very high function. So then you took the hijaab-e-naasut-e-tanaasuli, but that too was high. So you took the hijaab-e-hijaab-e-tanaasuli.
Hasan and Husayn are two Imams of truth, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them both.

Islam was established on seven pillars: *wilayah* (which is its most excellent, and through it and through the *wali* one reaches gnosis), and purity, and prayer, and zakah, and fasting, and hajj, and jihad.
Whoever says there is no god but Allah... with sincerity, will enter Paradise.
Fulfilling its rights and knowing its limits.
I and Sa'at were walking together, and I went a little ahead. For instance, you said about the two fingers that two fingers are like this, and I have moved one step ahead.
'bring, extend your hand, I will give you my...' ...I do it. I give bay'ah (pledge of allegiance).
where there is theft or, you can say, loss, whether on land or at sea, all of it happens because of not paying `zakat` properly.
You can cut off my neck, but bara'ah from Ali will not happen. Do whatever you want. Bara'ah from Ali will not happen.
When you honor your master so much and are in his obedience, then go, I release you. You will also be in our obedience.
Allah says, 'As you are, so shall it be for you.'

every nabi (prophet) was given an opponent, meaning a shaytan. Every nabi has a shaytan. You know, who was it for Musa 'alayh al-salam? Fir'awn (Pharaoh). Who was it for Ibrahim? Namrud. In this way, in every era, there has been a shaytan. But the Prophet says that for me, there are two shaytans.
What are you doing, Ali? My Imamat will be established through you. Meaning, you are the remainder.
This was your trust, I am the final limit (*hadd*), and after me is the Imam al-Zaman, I am giving it to you.
Ke na main apne se kisi ko paida kar sakta hun, na koi mujhe paida kar sakta hai. Balke hum sab ka paida karne wala koi dusra hai.
The condition of the world is also like this. What is the point of building a house here?
O Ali, you are my wasi here and in the hereafter.

there is a large circle, that is Islam. Within it is a smaller circle. The one in the smaller circle can claim to be in the larger circle too. But the one in the larger circle... a smaller circle is inside a larger circle. The one in the large circle cannot say he is in the smaller circle.

O Isa, I will relieve you of your duties and include you in my circle and my assembly of da'is. And I will save you from the foul language and evil deeds of the disbelievers, the deniers. And until your era is complete, I will give all believers superiority and elevation over the deniers of the wasi.
O Isa, your duty is over. I am relieving you. A great new Prophet is about to come.
Until I get the command from my elder, at that time it was Sayyidna Taher Saifuddin, until then, we will not give it.
I did not get it from the Majlis-e-Sulaymani Jawwad. And I... from Surat, from Burhanpur, from there I acquired it and printed this.
These questions are ordinary, what answer should I give? My children will give it.
law kuntu 'asartu fi 'asri muhammadan ma qassartu rutbata 's-salmani (If I had lived in the time of Muhammad, my rank would not have been less than that of Salman).
If I tell you that a large army is coming from behind this Faran mountain that will attack you, will you accept my word?
is there anyone who will support me and aid me?
whoever supports me today will be my khalifa (successor), my wasi (legatee), and my janishin (heir).
you cannot guide anyone. You cannot guide anyone. Whatever is related to guidance is from Us.
you should start every act with Bismillah, so that your every act will be blessed.
The secrets gathered from the first of the Da'is, that is Sayyidna Dhu'ayb bin Musa, to him are the secrets with Sayyidna Sulayman bin Hasan.
Look, brother, your sciences and our sciences up to Sayyidna Burhanuddin are one and the same... your `adwar` are also ours.
You keep reading, and he will keep explaining to you. Because, his mere thought is better than your certainty.
in our own body, in a believer's body, there are 360 nufus (souls/selves). And every nafs makes progress in every cycle.
la tuksiranna ya Rabbi fi hadha al-safarana (O my Lord, do not prolong our journey in this). O... O Lord, in this world, do not prolong our journey.

anal-yaqut al-ahmar (I am the red ruby). Anal-yaqut al-ahmar... wa Rasulullah salawatullahi 'ala al-yaqut al-asfar (I am the red ruby... and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessings be upon him, is the yellow ruby).
What is this? First it's the bow and then the prostration. This is not permissible in Islam and this is wrong.

Sir, you do not know the definition (ta'rif) of prostration. What is prostration called? Prostration is that in which the limbs, our seven limbs, that is, both knees, both our hands, and the forehead here, and the two feet. These six and one seven, seven limbs, when they touch the ground, only then is it a prostration. This is not a prostration.
This is the silent Book of Allah, and I am the speaking Book of Allah.
the tahajjud (late-night prayer) is not just one, there are many tahajjuds.
O Nu'man, you too should codify our shari‘ah.
How is your health? What's the matter? O Qadi, who all came to your side to inquire about your health? Who all came, the prominent ones?
he sees up to seven generations if there is a mu’min
Haza min maulak Ja‘far. This is written by your master, written by Ja‘far.
he is a kāfir (disbeliever) and a Muslim has no connection with him.
Lau-e-Shama'-e-Haqiqat ki... Fanus ki gardish se kya kya nazar ata hai (The flame of the candle of reality... what all is seen from the revolution of the lantern).

Kabhi aye Haqiqat-e-Muntazar, nazar aa libas-e-majaz mein, ke hazaron sajde tadap rahe hain meri jabin-e-niyaz mein (O Awaited Reality, appear sometime in the garment of metaphor, for thousands of prostrations are writhing on my forehead of supplication).
You created me from fire, and him You created from clay.
It must be that there is a creator of all of us.
My ummah will split into seventy-three sects, one of which will be saved.

The first thing that Allah created was the Intellect. So He said to it, 'Come forward,' and it came forward. Then He said to it, 'Go back,' and it went back. Through you I punish and through you I reward.
Give such strength to my wings that I may reach my nest. A long time has passed since our nest was left behind by us.
O people, what has happened to you that you worship idols? What are these statues to which you are devoted? Why do you worship idols? Why are you caught in this degradation and misguidance?
Son, you do the work of buying and selling. I will go do some work and come back.

Brother, what will you do with this idol? They don't speak, they don't express anything, they don't feel pain, they don't... it is of no harm, nor can they express happiness. What do you do with such idols?
I have brought this offering as a gift and I present it to these idols.
Your offering has been accepted by them, and these gods have given you many prayers. You can go.
Brother, what has happened to the shop? Today, there has been a great calamity. All the idols are broken. And what have you done, Ibrahim?
What can I do? An old woman brought this offering. All of them pounced on this offering, and this commotion happened.
Brother, what can I do? Look, ask your gods. All your gods have fought amongst themselves. What can I do?
Brother, after all, these are our idols, we worship them. Why are you humiliating them so much? What is this?
Brother, you say something, but this idol doesn't say anything. It doesn't know how to speak, it doesn't do anything, this poor thing isn't saying a word. Why are you making such a fuss?
O King, we are seeing that a boy will be born in your kingdom who will destroy your kingdom. He will ruin your kingdom, and such a person is coming, we are seeing this in the stars.
O Allah, what should I do for my child? You alone guide me.

The books that should be by our bedside are two. One is the Qur'an al-Majeed, which we should be reciting day and night. It should be read. And the second thing which we must always read with discipline is Da'ā'im al-Islām.

Bring me down from divinity, and then say whatever you wish about me. Lower me from divinity, O people, do not make me God (Rabb). Lower me from divinity, and then say whatever comes to your heart about me.

in praising Janāb-i-Alī, you can say whatever you wish. If someone says something you think is a lie, don't deny it. Did you see? If there is something in praise of Mawlā that you consider a lie, do not deny it; you might just not be able to understand it.
if a believer comes to me who is unaware of the sharī'at, I will crush his nose.
this is the sitting place of Shaitan. This is Shaitan's seat.
Whoever comes to me ignorant, I will break their nose, whether male or female believer.
A lie is totally a lie. A lie is not connected to any expediency (maslahat) or any other consideration. A lie is a lie. Al-kizbu kizbun (a lie is a lie).
The subtle bodies of our Shia are like our dense bodies. That the subtle bodies (lataif) of our Shia are our dense bodies (kasaif).

O Allah, I wished I had a son who would be my waris (heir), and who... but what can I do, I have become za'if, and my hair has turned white, and so I... and there is no such thing as having hope for a child now. And my wife has also become old.
Why are you so sad, O Zakariyya? Allah will grant you a ghulam (boy), will grant a son, who will be your successor, and who...
no one recognized Hazrat Ali except for me and God.

he did not recognize God with the recognition He deserves, but whatever recognition was achieved, it was by me and Ali. And no one recognized me except Ali and God. And no one recognized Ali except God and me.
Who can manage his praise, he is the servant of God. Who can manage the adornment of the highest paradise?
Women are incapable of giving birth to the like of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib.
Humans are proud of the power of their speech, [but] the ignorant do not have the etiquette to speak.
